selection.method: Top 3,500 unique lowercased English word forms from the cited wordfreq export, plus 250 curated mesh, emergency, SAR, navigation, and communications terms. Highest-frequency entries receive the shortest codes.

provenance.upstream: The export is derived from the wordfreq project; its exact upstream data version is not stated.
provenance.attribution: Frequency export: https://github.com/aparrish/wordfreq-en-25000. Upstream project: Robyn Speer, rspeer/wordfreq; see https://github.com/rspeer/wordfreq for the project citation, attribution, and source-specific terms. Upstream sources include Google Books Ngrams, Leeds Internet Corpus, Wikipedia, ParaCrawl, OpenSubtitles 2018, SUBTLEX, NewsCrawl, GlobalVoices, OSCAR, Twitter, and Reddit. SUBTLEX data authors include Marc Brysbaert et al.; OpenSubtitles 2018 attribution is retained.
provenance.upstream_snapshot_note: The wordfreq project documents its frequency data as a snapshot through about 2021; the export does not identify its exact build.
